Variations

This item can be obtained in the following variations. The 'fine' consumable can be cooked by using all fine material ingredients or may be found from chests where it can replace a normal drop with a fixed rate of 1/100

Primary Recipe Output

Ferment wine

You crush fruit to extract the juice, then transfer it to a fermentation vessel. You carefully monitor temperature and protect the mixture from contamination. With patience, you allow the natural process of fermentation to transform the fruity juice into wine.

A complex beverage created through the fermentation of fruit, transforming sweet juice into an alcoholic drink with distinct flavors and aromas.
